_about: The six product keys of a 0.6 source: `preset_name` becomes `title` (`name` stays beside it), `revision` becomes `version`, `content_sha256` becomes `sha256`, `preset_id` and `adaptation` drop when the last segment of the path of `url` is exactly their text and stay otherwise; a type named after a product becomes `contributed`, with its partner in `provider` and the old word as the first line of `notes`, and every other key is left as it is; a target that already exists wins and the old key stays.
